# Fairing

Fairing provides post-purchase attribution surveys, question management, and response data for measuring marketing performance.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/fairing/.

## Actions

- **List Questions** (read-only): Return the connected shop's complete Fairing question stream, optionally including targeting rules.
- **List Responses** (read-only): Return one page of the connected shop's survey responses, with optional question, time-window, and sort filters.
